description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-posthog MCP and cookieless SDK skill

test_cases.name: Official MCP and cookieless wiring
test_cases.description: Ensures PostHog install uses the official MCP, cookieless defaults, a privacy notice, and never the Cursor wizard.
test_cases.prompt: Add PostHog to this site with cookieless tracking and check why events are empty. Use the official MCP. Do not run the wizard.

test_cases.name: Intake findings handover forbids Linear create
test_cases.description: Ensures a prompt to pull PostHog suggestions into tickets stays on product-signal-intake with a findings handover and does not create Linear issues while PostHog is the only profile.
test_cases.prompt: Pull PostHog suggestions from funnel drop-offs into tickets this session.

test_cases.name: Missing PostHog tools writes blocked findings
test_cases.description: Ensures a Cloud Agent or headless host without PostHog tools after wk mcp posthog --install writes a product-signal-intake findings handover, marks queries BLOCKED, and does not invent Linear URLs or dashboard counts.
test_cases.prompt: Session A: wk mcp posthog --install. Official PostHog tools are still missing. Run product-signal-intake on the live site.
